forced.why: Gate NOT-READY 22/7/0; no FAIL is an unfixed rebuild defect. C03/C06/C07 grade the LIVE site's own crawl (7 live 404s behind redirects, 4 untitled source pages, 23 dead same-origin images; all recorded in audit/failures.json and accepted with reasons). C22 compares pixels with the OLD design; the operator asked for a total redesign. C17 is word recall that counts repeated menus and declared removals; sentence parity loses 0 of 13,966 source sentences. C19 and C23's single blocker are the deliberately inert forms (docs/BUILD-DECISIONS.md #4) - a LAUNCH BLOCKER until a form endpoint is wired (docs/DEPLOY.md). C23's 401 majors are clipped decorative shapes (0 visible overflow) and 24-44px tap targets (0 under 24px, WCAG 2.2 AA). Two adversarial QA rounds (74 findings, 66 confirmed, 66 fixed) plus one defect fixed after independent re-verification; docs refuter-checked.
